biography.value: Stanimir is the welcoming Vistana host at Tser Pool. He is warm, skeptical of Strahd, and a practical guide to the camp rather than a combatant.

description.value: At-will cantrip. Stanimir casts the 2014 friends spell; consult its text for the effect. This spell is not present in the local SRD compendium, so no linked spell activity can be created.
Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

Stanimir is a 9th-level spellcaster. Intelligence is his spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): friends, light, mage hand, prestidigitation; 1st level (4 slots): charm person, mage armor, shield, sleep; 2nd level (3 slots): misty step, suggestion; 3rd level (3 slots): bestow curse, phantom steed, major image; 4th level (3 slots): greater invisibility, stoneskin; 5th level (1 slot): dominate person.
